chunks: Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:

I said to him: A man married a woman, and when it was the night of consummation, the woman went to a male friend of hers and brought him into the bridal chamber. Then when the man went to have intercourse with his wife, the friend sprang up, and the two fought in the house, so the husband killed the friend. Then the woman rose and struck the man a blow and killed him on account of the friend.
He عليه السلام said: The woman is liable for the blood money of the friend, and she is to be executed for the husband.

key_terms.تُقْتَلُ بِٱلزَّوْجِ: she is executed in legal retaliation for the husband
key_terms.دِيَةَ ٱلصَّدِيقِ: the blood money owed for the slain friend
key_terms.لَيْلَةُ ٱلْبِنَاءِ: the night of consummation of the marriage
key_terms.يُبَاضِعُ أَهْلَهُ: to have marital intercourse with his wife

ai.seo_question: What is the legal ruling if a woman causes a violent confrontation in the marital home and then kills her husband?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who secretly brings another man into the bridal chamber, leading to violence and two deaths. The Imam عليه السلام rules that she must pay the blood money for her friend and is subject to execution for killing her husband.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5375 - Yunus ibn Abd Al-Rahman narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:

I asked Imam (as) about a man who married a woman, and on the night of consummation, the woman brought in a male friend of hers and let him enter the bridal chamber. When the husband approached to be intimate with his wife, the friend suddenly attacked him, and they fought in the house until the husband killed the friend. Then the woman struck the husband and killed him because of her friend.
Imam (as) said: "The woman must pay the blood money for her (male) friend, and she is to be executed for killing her husband."
